title: Microservices
description: Monitoring of the microservices profile (docker compose --profile microservices)

panels.title: Throughput (avg req/s)
panels.description: Requests handled by the server divided by the length of the selected time range. Select exactly one test run.

panels.title: Average response time
panels.description: Mean server-side processing time over the selected range (does not include the network trip to JMeter)

panels.title: p95 response time
panels.description: 95 % of requests in the selected range were faster than this (server side)

panels.title: p99 response time
panels.description: 99 % of requests in the selected range were faster than this (server side)

panels.title: Requests (total)
panels.description: Requests handled by the server in the selected range

panels.title: Errors (5xx)
panels.description: Server errors only: requests refused or timed out before reaching the application are counted by JMeter, not here

targets.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Response time: average, p50, p95, p99 (all endpoints)

targets.expr: sum by (application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{architecture="microservices", application=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Client latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Network + remote processing time seen by order-service

panels.title: Process CPU usage (of the container CPUs)
CPU throttling (s/s)
panels.description: Time the container wanted CPU but was capped by its limit: >0 means the CPU limit is the bottleneck

panels.title: Host CPU / memory (node-exporter)
panels.description: Docker VM running all containers (and the load generator if it runs in Docker)
